privileges.notes: Visa-free entry for up to 90 calendar days in any 180-day period when the Canadian residence permit is valid on the date of entry and is evidenced by the appropriate travel/documentation.

sources.description: Government of Georgia Ordinance listing Canada among countries whose visa/residence permit holders may enter without a visa
Law of Georgia on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 10(3¹) — statutory basis for visa-free entry by holders of visas/residence permits from designated countries
